personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: Two files, the player's marks moved and drawn after its shadow, the rivals' pinned by a test: a small change whose pixels are measured before and after, not a guess that ships a regression.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: Seventh PRD on the kart, for marks six pixels tall under the player's own wheels: more game, still no tool.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: The person picked among four measured looks in one round and it goes straight into the loop: fast, and the choice is on record.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: It closes the third fix of the same root, the effects born 8 px behind a kart the camera cannot see, the way the sparks and the trail were closed: from the kart's middle.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: A quick win a player feels at the wheel: their own drift now marks the road, and nothing else changes.

objection.text: Un PRD complet pour deux traces de 6 pixels sous un kart : c'est exactement le gadget que j'attendais de cet outil.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: The spec names the two test files, what each measures and that both are red today; the rivals' marks and the cap are pinned, so the change cannot spread.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: The spec is honest that the marks show in six rows at the screen's edge, at half the contrast on road; that is a lot of process for it.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Every option measured, the pick and the ones ruled out are written down: the next person who asks why the kart is not raised has the answer.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: One flag on a mark and one draw pass split in two, no camera change, no new cap: it fits how 2057 and 2061 were fixed.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: Small, felt by the player, and rolled back by one revert: the kind of change I want to ship quickly.
